issue.title: In VS Code 1.46, all "Run" CodeLens links incorrectly run with debugging

repository.name: Dart-Code
repository.description: Dart and Flutter support for VS Code

issue.body:
Same goes for **Dart: Run All Tests** (#2565), running from Test Tree, etc.

This appears to be a regression in VS Code, with `noDebug` being lost from the launch configs when calling `startDebugging`:

https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/100364

issue.title: `Dart: Run All Tests` does not run all tests after VSCode update to 1.46.0

labels.name: in testing
labels.description: Relates to test execution of Dart/Flutter tests for end users

labels.name: in commands
labels.description: Relates to commands (usually invoked from the command Palette)

repository.name: Dart-Code
repository.description: Dart and Flutter support for VS Code

issue.body:
## Problem
After VSCode updated to 1.46.0 the command `Dart: Run All Tests` only runs a portion of my tests and not all of them.
As you can see on the screenshot only three test suites are run, although there are nine test files inside my project. 
![Problem Screenshot](https://i.imgur.com/6JyRlkD.png)

It looks like it does not _find every test file_ inside the project, but the tests _inside the found test files_ are all being executed.

## Reproduction
1. Create a new project
2. Copy the existing test inside `widget_test` multiple times
3. Create a few duplicates of `widget_test.dart` (e.g. widget_2_test.dart)
4. Run `Dart: Run All Tests`

## Logs
[Dart-Code-Log-2020-05-03 10-45-37.txt](https://github.com/Dart-Code/Dart-Code/files/4791320/Dart-Code-Log-2020-05-03.10-45-37.txt)

body: @isidorn I don't know if this is related to #99743, but it appears to have changed in the most recent version and has broken a lot of functionality in Dart (there are many places we programatically spawn sessions without debugging - in some cases it's because debugging is not supported for those cases).

Hi @DanTup sorry about the breakage. We have fixed this in vscode insiders. Can you please try to reproduce with vscode insiders?
Also there will be a vscode recovery build soon which should contain the fix.

Potentially duplicate of https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/100265
Though if you can reproduce with vscode insiders, then it might be a different issue

@isidorn thanks for the quick response - though unfortunately it still repros using the example project above with this mornings Insiders:

issue.title: "Run without Debugging" causes "Start Debugging" to no longer run with debugging

labels.name: debug
labels.description: Debug viewlet, configurations, breakpoints, adapter issues

issue.body:
This one has been puzzling me for a few days! This happens with all debuggers - VS Code is incorrectly passing `noDebug: true` for a debug session if it was previously run without debugging.

To repro:

- create a simple JS script:
  ```
  console.log('test');
  ```
- Add a breakpoint and click Run -> Start Debugging and the breakpoint will be hit (correct)
- Run again with Run -> Run Without Debugging and the breakpoint will not be hit (correct)
- Run aagin with Run -> Start Debugging and the breakpoint will *not* be hit (incorrect)

@isidorn unsure if this is at all related to #100364 (seems like an opposite problem, perhaps related to the fix?)
